first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A short-haired man wearing a near-black jacket; the head, face, and upper body are repeatedly occluded by the foreground beams and posts, and a light-colored neckline and cuff are visible in the middle portion.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: A grayish-brown masonry-block wall behind the beams and posts, with a rough surface, a light-colored covering layer in places, and irregular joints between the blocks.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: Wide diagonal beams, vertical posts, and horizontal components in the foreground, ranging from dark brown to near-black, crisscrossing and occluding the person and the wall.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: A bright opening in the wall revealed through gaps in the frame in the later portion; part of its edge is nearly vertical, and its complete outline is occluded by the foreground.

entities.name: Blue-and-white bright area outside the window
entities.identification: A pale blue to grayish-white bright background area revealed through the window opening on the left in the later portion.
